items.title: Pensions minister sets summer 2027 launch for MoneyHelper Dashboard
items.summary: The pensions industry has welcomed plans for the public launch of the MoneyHelper Pension Dashboard next summer following an update from pensions minister Torsten Bell.

items.title: Paratus and Foresight report positive outcome from UK solar price insurance policy
items.summary: Energy price risk insurer Paratus and investment manager Foresight Group have completed an insurance arrangement covering six operational UK solar projects.

items.title: Willis warns El Niño weather patterns will test client operational resilience
items.summary: Willis research highlights that El Niño could disrupt global shipping routes, agricultural supplies and North American energy generation heading into 2027, requiring brokers to review multinational policy exposures.

items.title: Anthropic lists in record-breaking IPO raising $107bn
items.summary: Anthropic has begun trading on public markets following an initial public offering that raised $107bn and surpassed SpaceX.

items.title: Two people die in New Hampshire log cabin house fire
items.summary: The New Hampshire State Fire Marshal reported that two residents died following an accidental house fire at a log cabin-style home in Sanbornton.

items.title: Canopius appoints Katy Sivyer as Head of International Property Treaty
items.summary: Canopius Group has appointed Katy Sivyer to succeed Toby Orrow, who is retiring from his role as Head of International Property Treaty in early 2027.
